name: Vena Tora Crusafontia
original_name: ベナ・トール・クルサフォンティア
source:
"Hey, you look so pissed off...! You're a good young man in the middle of the day!"

[url=https://vndb.org/c43557]Rufen's[/url] senpai.

Despite her small stature, she's always in high spirits. When she sees Rufen, she hits him as a conditional reflex.

She's always with her roommate, [url=https://vndb.org/c43560]Pit[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111116155224/http://senz.jp/chara/chara8.html#vena]official website[/url]]
